name: ox-ai-scan-review
description: AI-assisted dependency security review for GitHub repositories

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @ox-scan/shared" "npm run dev -w @ox-scan/api" "npm run dev -w @ox-scan/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
